spec.description: Low-power 12-bit digital temperature sensor (0.0625°C resolution, ±2°C max from -25°C to 85°C) with SMBus/two-wire/I2C interface and a programmable open-drain ALERT output. Up to four devices can share one bus via the ADD0 pin.
spec.logic_voltage: Referenced to V+; VIH = 0.7 x V+ min, absolute maximum 4V on SCL/SDA/ADD0 - not 5V tolerant

pins.note: Pin 5. Supply 1.4V to 3.6V - use the Uno 3.3V rail, NOT 5V (abs max 4V). Place a 0.01uF bypass capacitor between V+ and GND close to the part.
Pin 2. Common ground with the Uno.
Pin 1. Serial clock. Pull up to 3.3V with 5k ohm. Do not let the Uno's internal 5V pull-up be enabled (driver disables it).
Pin 6. Open-drain serial data. Pull up to 3.3V with 5k ohm; the sensor can only sink 3 mA.
Pin 4. Address select; tied to GND for address 0x48 (1001000b). Must be connected - V+/SDA/SCL select 0x49/0x4A/0x4B.
Pin 3. Open-drain over/under-temperature output, active low by default (POL=0). Requires a 5k ohm pull-up to 3.3V; 3.3V is a valid logic-high for the Uno's 5V input.

init_sequence.purpose: Explicitly set power-up defaults: OS=0, R1R0=11 (12-bit, read-only), F1F0=00 (1 fault), POL=0 (ALERT active low), TM=0 (comparator mode), SD=0 (continuous conversion); CR1CR0=10 (4 Hz), EM=0 (12-bit normal mode)
Set pointer to temperature register and read MSB then LSB; 12 left-justified bits, 0.0625 °C/LSB, two's complement

warnings: Power V+ from the Uno 3.3V pin only. Supply range is 1.4V to 3.6V; absolute maximum is 4V. Connecting 5V will destroy the part.

SCL, SDA and ADD0 have an absolute maximum of 4V. Pull SDA/SCL/ALERT up to 3.3V (recommended 5k ohm each), never to 5V. The Arduino AVR Wire library enables internal pull-ups to 5V by default; the sketch disables them with digitalWrite(A4/A5, LOW) after Wire.begin(). A proper bidirectional level shifter is the safest option.
No other 5V-pulled-up I2C device may share the bus with the TMP102 unless a level shifter isolates it.
Pull-up current into any pin must not exceed 3 mA (5k ohm to 3.3V gives ~0.66 mA).
ADD0 must be tied: GND=0x48 (used here), V+=0x49, SDA=0x4A, SCL=0x4B. Update TMP102_ADDR if you change it.
Place a 0.01uF bypass capacitor between V+ and GND as close to the part as possible; it is required for proper operation.
ALERT is open-drain and needs its own pull-up (to 3.3V). Default is active low (POL=0), comparator mode, thresholds THIGH=80°C and TLOW=75°C.
Temperature register reads 0°C until the first conversion completes (~10 ms after power-up). Default rate is 4 Hz, so new data arrives every 250 ms.
The bus interface times out if SCL is held low for more than ~30 ms; keep SCL at or above 1 kHz.
Accuracy is ±2°C max (-25°C to 85°C), ±0.5°C typical, no calibration required. Temperatures above 128°C require extended mode (EM=1, 13-bit).
